mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reconciliation_cutoff (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, cutoff_id, closed_at, source_watermark, posting_watermark, receipt_watermark, watermarks_complete, state, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{cutoffId}, #{closedAt}, #{sourceWatermark}, #{postingWatermark}, #{receiptWatermark}, #{complete}, 'CLOSED', 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id

INSERT INTO source_execution_fact (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, source_service, command_id, business_effect_key, fact_kind, quantity, occurred_at, watermark_token, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{sourceService}, #{commandId}, #{effectKey}, #{factKind}, #{quantity}, #{occurredAt}, #{watermark}, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at=updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.sku_id, b.on_hand_qty, b.reserved_qty, k.serial_enabled, COALESCE((SELECT l.on_hand_after FROM stock_ledger l WHERE l.enterprise_id=b.enterprise_id AND l.warehouse_id=b.warehouse_id AND l.balance_id=b.id ORDER BY l.balance_version DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS ledger_qty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.remaining_qty) FROM reservation_line l JOIN reservation r ON r.enterprise_id=l.enterprise_id AND r.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id AND r.id=l.reservation_id WHERE l.enterprise_id=b.enterprise_id AND l.warehouse_id=b.warehouse_id AND l.balance_id=b.id AND r.state IN ('TRIED','CONFIRMED')),0) AS remaining_qty, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM local_serial s WHERE s.enterprise_id=b.enterprise_id AND s.warehouse_id=b.warehouse_id AND s.balance_id=b.id AND s.state IN ('HOLD_RECEIVED','AUTHORIZED','SEALED')) AS serial_count FROM stock_balance b JOIN sku k ON k.enterprise_id=b.enterprise_id AND k.id=b.sku_id WHERE b.enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND b.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND b.created_at < #{cutoff} AND b.id > #{cursor} ORDER BY b.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reconciliation_scan (id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,cutoff_id,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{id},#{enterpriseId},#{warehouseId},#{cutoffId},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reconciliation_scan WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND cutoff_id=#{cutoffId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reconciliation_case (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, cutoff_id, case_type, discrepancy_code, scope_id, sku_id, expected_qty, actual_qty, state, evidence_ref, remediation_operation_id, approved_by, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{cutoffId}, #{caseType}, #{code}, #{scopeId}, #{skuId}, #{expected}, #{actual}, 'OPEN', #{evidence}, NULL, NULL, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE approved_by=IF(state='CLOSED',NULL,approved_by), remediation_operation_id=IF(state='CLOSED',NULL,remediation_operation_id), state=IF(state='CLOSED','OPEN',state), discrepancy_code=VALUES(discrepancy_code), expected_qty=VALUES(expected_qty), actual_qty=VALUES(actual_qty), evidence_ref=VALUES(evidence_ref), updated_at=#{now}, version=version+1
